content: When the word immediately following the question word is a noun, the window size is set to ‘3’. This size ‘3’ means that we iterate through the next ‘3’ words (if present) to check if any of the word is both 'Noun' and 'Subject', If so, the word is considered as ‘LAT’/Focus Word. Else the word that is present very next to the question word is considered as ‘LAT’.
